items.sentenceBn: সোনালি ভালুকের থুঁতনির ওপরে চকচকে কালো নাকটি খাবারের তীব্র গন্ধ শুঁকছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: His golden bear snout is catching delicious scents from the picnic tables.
grammar.simplePast: His golden bear snout followed the food trail straight into camp.
grammar.simplePresent: A golden bear snout leads a hungry bear straight toward leftover food.
grammar.question: What scents is the golden bear snout smelling right now?

items.name: Ear
items.sentence: Sunset rays rim his round sunlit brown bear ear in bright orange light.
items.sentenceBn: সূর্যাস্তের আলো তার গোল রোদমাখা বাদামি ভালুকের কানের ধারগুলো উজ্জ্বল কমলা রঙে রাঙিয়ে তুলেছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: His sunlit brown bear ear is glowing warmly against the bright evening sky.
grammar.simplePast: His sunlit brown bear ear perked up as crows squawked nearby.
grammar.simplePresent: A sunlit brown bear ear stands tall and alert when food is close.
grammar.question: What color lights up the edge of the sunlit brown bear ear?

items.name: Forest
items.sentence: Cool blue forest shadows stretch behind the bear across the edge of the campsite.
items.sentenceBn: শিবিরের প্রান্তে ভালুকটির পেছনে শীতল নীল বনের ছায়া বিস্তৃত হয়ে আছে।

grammar.presentContinuous: The cool blue forest shadows are deepening as evening settles over camp.
grammar.simplePast: The cool blue forest shadows stayed quiet behind the bright sunset glow.
grammar.simplePresent: Cool blue forest shadows contrast sharply with warm golden campsite lights.
grammar.question: What trees stand faintly inside the cool blue forest shadows?
